Video type: Geometry Dash started as a one-touch game
facts: The original gameplay was built around a simple idea: tap or hold to jump and avoid obstacles.

Video type: RobTop created Geometry Dash
facts: The game was developed by Swedish developer Robert Topala under the name RobTop Games.

Video type: Geometry Dash is a rhythm-based platformer
facts: Players must time their movements with obstacles and music to survive each level.

Video type: One mistake can restart your entire run
facts: In normal mode
column3: hitting an obstacle sends the player back to the beginning of the level.

Video type: Practice Mode gives you checkpoints
facts: Players can place checkpoints to practise difficult sections without restarting the whole level.

Video type: Players can create their own levels
facts: The built-in level editor lets players design custom stages using objects  obstacles  triggers and music.

Video type: Geometry Dash has many different game modes
facts: Players can transform into cubes  ships  balls  UFOs  waves  robots  spiders and swings.

Video type: The ship mode changes how gravity feels
facts: Holding the button makes the ship rise while releasing it makes the ship descend.

Video type: Wave mode moves in a zigzag pattern
facts: Holding and releasing the button makes the wave travel diagonally in alternating directions.

Video type: The Demon difficulty has five ratings
facts: The Demon category includes Easy Demon  Medium Demon  Hard Demon  Insane Demon and Extreme Demon.

Video type: Stereo Madness is the first main level
facts: This iconic beginner level introduces players to the basic jumping mechanics and obstacle timing.

Video type: The level editor became a huge part of the game
facts: Community creators can build elaborate levels that go far beyond the original official stages.

Video type: Update two point two introduced the Swing mode
facts: The December twenty nineteen update introduced a new movement style that lets players swing between directions.
column3: Update two point two introduced the Swing mode. It lets players swing between directions.

Video type: Update two point two added Platformer mode
facts: Players can move more freely through levels instead of following the traditional automatic scrolling gameplay.
column3: Update two point two added Platformer mode. Players can move freely through levels.

Video type: Dash became a new official main level
facts: The level Dash arrived with update two point two and showcased many of its new gameplay features.
column3: Dash became a new official main level with update two point two.

Video type: Moons became a new collectible
facts: Update two point two introduced Moons as a collectible alongside the existing progression and reward systems.
column3: Moons became a new collectible in update two point two.

Video type: Update two point two added over seven hundred icons
facts: The huge update brought more than seven hundred new icons for players to unlock and customise.
column3: Update two point two added over seven hundred new icons.

Video type: The update introduced over one hundred achievements
facts: Players received more than one hundred new achievements to unlock through different challenges and activities.
column3: The update introduced over one hundred new achievements.

Video type: Geometry Dash added over thirty new Gauntlets
facts: The two point two update expanded the Gauntlet collection with more than thirty additional Gauntlets.
